title: Gravity particles, ported to C++
summary: The 2024 pygame gravity particle sim ported line for line to C++ with SDL2, run from VS Code.

title: 360,000 particles in 3D with C++
summary: The 3D gravity particle sim ported to C++ with SDL2 and OpenMP: ten times the particles of the Python version, still above 60 FPS, with an orbit camera.

title: Gravity particles in 3D with an orbit camera
summary: The gravity particle sim rebuilt in 3D with pygame and numpy: spawn particle clouds, then drag to orbit the camera and scroll to zoom while they swing around the sun.

title: 1,000,000 particles in 9 languages
summary: The same 1M-particle gravity sim in Python, NumPy, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C and C++, raced to 150 frames on one CPU core, then C++ on all four cores is the only one past 60 FPS.

title: Gravity, black hole and galaxy sims in plain Java
summary: Three Swing simulations with no libraries: an N-body gravity sandbox, a black hole that follows your mouse and swallows particles, and a spiral galaxy with thousands of stars in stable orbits.

title: Self-driving car learns a track with NEAT
summary: A population of cars with five radar sensors evolves neural networks with NEAT until they can drive a full lap.

title: Thousands of particles under gravity
summary: An N-body particle simulation in pygame, sped up with numba, where you spawn lines and clusters of particles and watch gravity pull them together.
